note: Both sets are accurate on the claims they share: the Prandtl tip-loss drop over the outboard 5%, the 4° maximum pitch at low wind speeds, the ~90 m force peak below rated, and the design/optimal TSR values are all supported by the text with faithful quotes. Set A additionally captures the design-point blade pitch (0°) and the optimal blade pitch (−1.0°) at maximum CP, both directly stated in the same sentence as the TSR values, so it covers the full design-point/optimum pair without error. Set B omits these two pitch values, leaving the design point only half specified. Neither set invents or misbinds anything.
remarks: Both sets omit other notable facts on the page, e.g. Region 3 torque saturation at rated torque with pitch-to-feather to maintain rated rotor speed, the negligible Region 2.5, and the tip-unloading/power-loss trade-off — these are absent from both so they do not differentiate the sets. The 'optimal' TSR/pitch values are described in the text as the optimum shown in the CP and CT curves of Figure 3-2; binding them to 'maximum CP' is a reasonable but slightly interpretive condition.
